+import type { IncomingMessage } from 'http'
+
+/**
+ * Determines whether an incoming HTTP request declares a valid,
+ * single "chunked" Transfer-Encoding. This is used to detect and
+ * reject ambiguous or malformed Transfer-Encoding headers that could
+ * otherwise be used for HTTP request smuggling attacks, particularly
+ * when combined with rewrites.
+ */
+export function isHttpRequestChunked(req: IncomingMessage): boolean {
+  const transferEncoding = req.headers['transfer-encoding']
+
+  if (!transferEncoding) {
+    return false
+  }
+
+  // Transfer-Encoding should not be a list with multiple values, and
+  // the only value we accept is exactly "chunked" (case-insensitive).
+  if (Array.isArray(transferEncoding)) {
+    return false
+  }
+
+  const values = transferEncoding.split(',').map((v) => v.trim().toLowerCase())
+
+  return values.length === 1 && values[0] === 'chunked'
+}

+// Utility to guard against catastrophic backtracking when regex patterns
+// are supplied at runtime via $data references.
+//
+// We cannot fully detect all ReDoS-prone patterns, but we can cheaply
+// reject the most common vulnerable constructs:
+//  - nested quantifiers, e.g. (a+)+, (a*)*, (a|a)*
+//  - overly long patterns (which amplify backtracking cost)
+//
+// This is intentionally conservative: it may reject some safe patterns,
+// but it prevents the most severe catastrophic-backtracking cases while
+// still allowing normal usage of the `pattern` keyword.
+
+const MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH = 1000
+
+// Matches a repeated group that itself contains a repetition or an
+// alternation with overlapping branches, e.g. (a+)+, (a*)*, (a|a)*
+const NESTED_QUANTIFIER_RE = /(\([^)]*[+*][^)]*\)|\([^)]*\|[^)]*\))[+*]/
+
+export class UnsafePatternError extends Error {
+  constructor(pattern: string) {
+    super(`ajv: pattern "${pattern}" rejected as potentially unsafe (ReDoS)`)
+  }
+}
+
+export function assertSafePattern(pattern: unknown): void {
+  if (typeof pattern !== "string") return
+  if (pattern.length > MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH) {
+    throw new UnsafePatternError(pattern)
+  }
+  if (NESTED_QUANTIFIER_RE.test(pattern)) {
+    throw new UnsafePatternError(pattern)
+  }
+}
+
+export function safePattern(pattern: unknown): string {
+  assertSafePattern(pattern)
+  return pattern as string
+}
